title: Grateful Dead Live at Mammoth Gardens on 1970-04-24

ai_review.summary: An incomplete Denver Fillmore show with modest recording quality; historically interesting but not a great listening experience.
ai_review.review: The tape captures only part of the April‑1970 Denver performance at the Fillmore on Colfax and the audio is far from pristine. Reviewers note that it isn’t a complete show nor a high‑quality recording, though they appreciate its place in local Dead history. No specific musical highlights are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; it points out both incomplete performance and subpar recording, leading to an overall below‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not a great recording; appears incomplete and lacks clarity, offering limited listenability.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show is incomplete, making it difficult to assess pacing or flow.
